Kerala University Decisions Delayed Amidst Syndicate Deadlock

A deadlock within the Syndicate of Kerala University has led to delays in decision-making. This situation comes shortly after Vice Chancellors (VCs) in the state faced criticism. The Vice Chancellor of the Central University of Kerala was noted to have attended an RSS event during this period.
